Meta.homeTitle: MS Welfare Trust – Donate to education, healthcare and relief
Meta.homeDescription: Munira Shoaib Welfare Trust is a registered charitable trust in India. Donations are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80G.

Layout.reg: Registered under Sections 12A and 80G of the Income-tax Act, 1961

Home.h1: Help families in need, with every rupee accounted for
Home.intro: Our new website is being built. Online donations with instant 80G receipts are coming soon.
Home.trust1: Get a receipt for tax deduction under Section 80G when you add your PAN.
Home.trust2: Annual reports and audited accounts are published on our Transparency page.
Home.trust3: Pay by UPI, cards or net banking through a secure, RBI-regulated gateway.
Home.causesLead: Choose a cause, or give to the general fund and we'll direct it where it's needed most.
Home.bandH: Every donation is receipted the moment it is received
Home.bandP: You get an email with your receipt number. Your PAN is used only for your 80G receipt and the Trust's tax filings.
